description:
Fetch aggregated visual context: recent states, frequently accessed states, active transitions, and memory stats. Call this at session start to orient before performing UI actions. Use get_session_context instead of recall_memory when initializing session awareness rather than searching for specific visual targets.

Returns recent states list, frequent states, active transitions, cache hit telemetry, and database sizing.

include_centroids.description: Whether to export embedding centroids out-of-band

name: get_session_context
